summary: Scope agent-card runtime-start job counts to the selected agent

replay.detail: Read-only count projections change; no replay or retained-state changes.

schema.detail: Existing runtime-start subject indexes and stored row shapes are unchanged.

rules.detail: No launch, cleanup, proof or authority rules change.

compatibility.detail: Agent-card running_jobs, revoked_running_jobs, unresolved_jobs and revoked_unresolved_jobs now describe that agent rather than all owner-local starts. Field names and types are unchanged; aggregate store queries retain their owner-wide meaning.

downtime.detail: No migration or additional downtime is required.

manual.detail: No operator action or configuration is required.

recovery.detail: Counts do not close starts or change recovery eligibility.
